analysis.reason: The figure is the core ISO/IEC 25010 quality model and visually organizes the nine software product quality characteristics and their sub-characteristics, which are central to the article's explanation.
analysis.replacement_text: The ISO/IEC 25010 software product quality model groups quality into nine characteristics: functional suitability, performance efficiency, compatibility, interaction capability, reliability, security, maintainability, flexibility, and safety. The diagram also shows each characteristic’s sub-characteristics, such as functional completeness, time behaviour, interoperability, usability-related traits, faultlessness, confidentiality, modularity, adaptability, and risk-related safety attributes.
